intent_snapshot.goal: The revisit session reader reads user, assistant and toolResult lines into pointed events with call-result links, review_retro.ts --json emits one evidence document with a fixed absolute window, scope and candidate chains, --since/--until reproduce a window, the text report leads with candidate chains and moves usage, the tool histogram and rounds/task to an appendix, and regex labels become unverified markers (#330 S1; Spec docs/specs/revisit-evidence-chain.spec.md D1-D5).

acceptance.assertion: In tests/review-retro-analyzer.test.ts, run([..., "--json"]) prints one JSON document with contract "immune_brain/revisit_evidence/v1", absolute ISO window since/until, scope and skipped_lines; every event carries session, line, entry_id, timestamp, role, cwd, task_id and run_id, with the literal "unknown" when the line and its linked call carry no id; a tool_result links to its tool_call by toolCallId through call_line, an unmatched toolResult has call_line null, and tool_call events keep the author field (Spec D1).

In tests/review-retro-analyzer.test.ts, --since/--until select lines with since <= t < until (a line at since is in, a line at until is out), two runs with the same --since/--until print byte-identical output, <days> prints the absolute since/until it resolved once, and each of these exits non-zero with a usage error: <days> together with --since, --until without --since, an unparsable ISO value, and until <= since (Spec D2).

In tests/review-retro-analyzer.test.ts, a user line holding a <skill name="revisit" ...> block followed by an instruction yields one user_input event with skill "revisit" and the instruction text, a Skill-only user line yields user_input with an empty instruction, and a session of 19 imm_kernel_canary tool calls with no user line reports "user inputs: 0" and no user_input event (Spec D1, D3; #330 RC1, RC3).

In tests/review-retro-analyzer.test.ts, a request_stop call whose toolResult reports state "applied" and lifecycle "stopped" yields a tool_result with stop_applied, and a later user input plus a Kernel call on the same task_id produces no user_resume candidate for that stop (Spec D3; #330 RC2).

In tests/review-retro-analyzer.test.ts, candidates[] lists each kind of Spec D3 with kind, key and at most five session#line pointers and no cause, class or severity field: repeated_block for one blocking acceptance_id in two registrations of the same (cwd, task_id) but not in one; review_without_verdict for a verdict-less submit_review without a receipt but not with one; batch_oscillation for one batch_id entering needs_human twice with another state between but not once; user_resume for a stop/error/aborted turn_end then a user_input then a Kernel call on the same task_id but not on a different task_id (Spec D3).

In tests/review-retro-analyzer.test.ts, the text report prints the header with absolute window, then "=== candidate chains (locating only; not causes) ===", then "user inputs: <n>", then finding totals, then "=== appendix: locating context (never a cause) ===" holding usage, the tool histogram and rounds/task, in that order (Spec D4).

In tests/review-retro-analyzer.test.ts and tests/review-retro-audit.test.ts, a finding whose summary matches the bookkeeping pattern keeps its structured kind and gains markers ["bookkeeping"], text totals read "blocking: <n> | advisory: <n> | bookkeeping marker (unverified): <n>" with the same counts as before, and the audit candidate-improvements section labels jitter matches "jitter marker (unverified)" with unchanged membership and content-rework count (Spec D5).

tests/pi-canary-packed-loader.test.ts finds plugins/immune-brain/skills/revisit/scripts/session_evidence.ts in the packed tarball; plugins/immune-brain/dist/revisit.md documents --json, --since and --until; and .changeset/revisit-evidence-chain-s1-evidence-output.md declares a minor release of immune-brain (Spec D1, D2, D9).
